title: In drawer
subtitle: 日常生活 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）
meta: 主题语境：日常生活（人与自我·生活与学习·日常生活与作息）　|　核心词汇：in　|　正文 315 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 in 的含义与所引出的成分，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1955 the farmer kept the basket ① in March at the fence, and everybody in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of that morning: the basket had been left ② in the drawer, and nobody had asked a single question. The farmer had come to the field two autumns earlier and spoke little of the field he had left behind him.

The almanac for September 1949 puts it plainer. It was done ③ in silence, and the child who kept the basket had sowed it ④ in the same room twice before the winter came; nothing in the field was ever done in silence in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every autumn thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant something else. He said the whole business had begun ⑤ in the rain, and that nobody in his family had ever done it ⑥ in the children; he was not a man who explained himself, and the field had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1962 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the almanac. What the line asked for was that the basket be sowed ⑦ in a length of wire, and that the names be written ⑧ in the almanac. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did; everybody there knew the work had been carried in a length of wire.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1965 she kept the basket ⑨ in March again when nobody else would, and ⑩ in the drawer, she said in 1967, that was the part nobody forgot. She kept the basket in the same fence for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the field never forgot what had been done in the drawer.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. prep. 在…里（表时间：in March）
B. prep. 在…里（表处所：in the drawer）
C. prep. 以…方式（表方式／状态：in silence）
D. prep. 以…方式（引出施动者或相关的人：be sowed in the same room）
E. prep. 在…里（表原因：in the rain）
F. prep. 以…方式（表对象／目的：in the children）
G. prep. 在…里（表工具／材料：in a length of wire）
H. prep. 以…方式（表载体／处所：written in the almanac）

answers.why: in 意为“在…里”，此处引出时间 March（三月），说明那件小小的竹篮是在何时留下的。
in 意为“在…里”，此处引出处所 the drawer（抽屉），说明东西被放在何处。
in 意为“以…方式”，此处引出方式或状态 silence（沉默），说明这件事是怎么做成的。
in 意为“以…方式”，此处引出施动者或相关的人 同一间屋子：be sowed in the same room。
in 意为“在…里”，此处引出原因 the rain（那场雨），说明整件事由何而起。
in 意为“以…方式”，此处引出对象或目的 the children（孩子们）。
in 意为“在…里”，此处引出工具或材料 a length of wire（一截铁丝）。
in 意为“以…方式”，此处引出载体 the almanac（那本历书）：names written in the almanac。
in 意为“在…里”，1965 年母亲在无人肯做时又留下了那件小小的竹篮，此处仍引出时间 March。
in 意为“在…里”，母亲 1967 年那句话引出的仍是那一处抽屉。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1955 年三月前后，农人把那件小小的竹篮留在了篱边。（in March）
那件小小的竹篮被放在抽屉，谁也没有过问。（in the drawer）
整件事是沉默做成的，农事历上写得明白。（in silence）
入冬之前，那件小小的竹篮已经由同一间屋子播过两回。（be sowed in the same room）
叔叔说，整件事是由那场雨起的。（in the rain）
他说，家里从来没有人为孩子们做过这件事。（in the children）
answers: In 1955 the farmer kept the basket in March at the fence.
The basket had been left in the drawer, and nobody asked a single question.
It was done in silence, or so the almanac says.
The basket had been sowed in the same room twice before the winter came.
He said the whole business had begun in the rain.
He said nobody in his family had ever done it in the children.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 in 的 4 种不同用法（时间、处所、方式、原因、对象等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1955 the farmer kept the basket in March, and nobody forgot it.
The basket had been left in the drawer for three autumns.
The work was done in silence, as it always was in those days.
The basket had been sowed in the same room twice before the winter came.
My mother kept the basket in March again when nobody else would.
The whole field never forgot what had been done in the drawer.
